title: Python: IndexError (Off-by-One Loop)
error_message:
IndexError: list index out of range
  File "solution.py", line 4, in print_scores
    print(f"Student {i+1}: {scores[i]}")
expected_fix_summary: Change range(len(scores) + 1) to range(len(scores)) or use 'for i, score in enumerate(scores)'.

title: Python: RecursionError (Missing Base Case)
error_message:
RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded while calling a Python object
  File "solution.py", line 3, in compute_factorial
expected_fix_summary: Add base case: 'if n <= 1: return 1' before the recursive step.

title: JavaScript: TypeError (Cannot read properties of undefined)
error_message:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')
    at getUserDisplayName (app.js:3:25)
expected_fix_summary: Use optional chaining (user?.profile?.name?.toUpperCase()) and provide a default fallback value.

title: Java: NullPointerException (Uninitialized Array Elements)
error_message:
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.length()" because "names[i]" is null
	at StudentRegistry.main(StudentRegistry.java:6)
expected_fix_summary: Initialize each string in the array before calling methods on it, or check if names[i] != null.

title: C++: Segmentation Fault / Out of Bounds
error_message: Segmentation fault (core dumped) / undefined behavior on accessing numbers[3]
expected_fix_summary: Change condition to 'i < numbers.size()' or use range-based for loop 'for (int num : numbers)'.

title: Python: Infinite Loop Logic Bug (Binary Search)
error_message: (No crash/exception, but program hangs in an infinite loop when target is not present)
expected_fix_summary: Update pointer to 'low = mid + 1' so the search space strictly decreases on each step.
